goal: Roll one strike die in Karst: Zero Horizon, with cover and momentum. Then every roll in a fight can be replayed.

app.name: karst-strike
limits: It resolves one attacking die against no defending hits; the opposed pool sums the dice.
Plating, resilience and subsystem rupture are outside it.
app.title: Strike die
app.purpose: Decide what one d6 of a strike pool does against an undefended target behind no cover, low cover or a solid bulkhead, after the striker moved some sectors.

fields.name: cover
fields.means: the cover between the striker and the target

fields.name: momentum
fields.means: sectors the striker moved before the strike, 4 meaning 4 or more

meanings.critical: one net hit from a natural 6
meanings.blocked: line of sight is blocked, no hit

rules.why: src/CombatEngine.lex.tex resolveOpposedNetHits: cover level 2, a solid bulkhead, gives 0 net hits (bulkheadFullCoverBlocksLineOfSight)
src/game/nemesisEngine.ts: the strike pool scores critical 6s
README Subsystem 2: the opposed strike pool hits on 4+
src/CombatEngine.lex.tex momentumBonusHit: 4 moved sectors add one hit to the pool
src/CombatEngine.lex.tex: the momentum hit pays for the low cover auto-evade, so the natural 6 still lands
src/CombatEngine.lex.tex resolveOpposedNetHits: atk + momentumBonusHit minus coverAutoEvade leaves one net hit

app.otherwiseWhy: src/CombatEngine.lex.tex coverAutoEvade: low cover cancels the single hit without a momentum charge, and a face below 4 without momentum scores none

properties.why: nothing hits through a solid bulkhead
only a natural 6 is a critical
partialCoverGrantsOneAutoEvade: without a momentum charge low cover cancels the one hit
a solid bulkhead always blocks line of sight

stakeholders.name: Player
stakeholders.text: Rolls the strike pool and needs every die resolved by the rules, the same on every screen.

stakeholders.name: Game designer
stakeholders.text: Tunes cover and momentum and needs the never-hit guarantees to survive every change.

components.name: Karst client
components.text: The Karst: Zero Horizon client, src/game/nemesisEngine.ts, which rolls the pool and shows the combat breakdown.

components.name: karst-kernel
components.text: The no_std, forbid(unsafe_code) Rust kernel in crates/karst-kernel that realizes the Nemesis Core engine.

threats.name: Loaded die
threats.text: A client sends a face it did not roll, to turn a miss into a hit.
threats.accepted: The app resolves the face it is given; the roll itself belongs to the client, and the skirmish replay shows every face sent.

threats.name: Shot through a bulkhead
threats.text: A strike through solid cover is counted as a hit, so a unit behind a bulkhead takes damage.

control.name: Line of sight proved
control.text: The app never answers hit behind solid cover, and the engine proves 0 net hits at cover level 2.

threats.name: Momentum without the move
threats.text: A strike behind low cover is credited a momentum charge the striker did not earn.

control.name: Four sectors required
control.text: Without 4 moved sectors low cover cancels the hit, proved for every request.

quality.text: Each answer names what the die did: critical, hit, miss or blocked.
quality.measureText: Answers that are not one of the four outcome words.
